cues: Evans: hot tempered and greedy, swearing at the corpse and digging on after two pricks.
Hooker: careful and watchful, the story's eyes, the one who understands, too late.
And Chang-hi, who never appears on stage, yet wins: the shrewd man the robbers looked down on out-thinks them from beyond death.
